pages.title: Luminous Mesoglea
pages.text: The clear jelly of a brine jelly's bell, still faintly glowing: almost all water, held in a web of collagen. Dropped by Brine Jellies in Titan's hidden ocean. It lights membranes, and the Chemical Reactor draws a gel from it.
$(thing)Dropped by$(): Brine Jelly.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Bioluminescent Membrane.
